title: JobFair: A Framework for Benchmarking Gender Hiring Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of explicit gender labels ('Gender: Male', 'Gender: Female', or neutral) in real anonymized resumes, followed by evaluating LLM scoring and ranking differences (Ranking After Scoring) to measure level, spread, statistical, and taste-based biases.

Counterfactual modification of resumes to alter home distance (close or not close) and last year's working status (employed or not employed) to illustrate and test for statistical bias in candidate evaluations.
